text:
maria: quick heads-up — brought up v3.1-int4 in a 5% canary this morning. latency and p99 look good 👍 but short_factual slice MRR is down ~3.2% (p=0.004). want to decide auto-fallback thresholds before we promote. cc @anika @sam

sam: can you post sample sizes and CI on the MRR drop?

maria: sample sizes: control 12,432, treatment 12,300. MRR ctrl=0.274 -> trt=0.265. bootstrap CI for diff = [-0.012, -0.008]. hallucination (fact halluc rate) up +0.5% abs on same slice.

anika: hmm that's non-trivial. my proposal: enable an auto-fallback when ANY of the following occurs for a slice with samples >=5k:
- primary metric (MRR_short_factual) delta <= -1.5% AND p <= 0.01
- OR absolute MRR drop >= 2.0% (regardless of p)
Also add a hysteresis window: require the condition to hold for 3 consecutive 15m windows before triggering.

maria: that sounds reasonable. want to avoid noisy single-window flips.

ops-bot: suggested runbook command to create the policy:
```
/runtool create-fallback --model v3.1-int4 --metric mrr_short_factual --delta -0.02 --p-threshold 0.01 --min-samples 5000 --hysteresis 3x15m --notify-channel #incidents
```

leo: alternative: reduce canary to 1% immediately and run the slice-targeted smoke eval (short_factual, fewshot prompts) to get more power before letting an automated policy run.

sam: +1 to shrinking traffic and running a targeted eval. if we still see the same gap at 1% with >5k samples we should let the auto-fallback be the safety net. also we should log the decision in the rollout audit (ticket).

anika: small tweak: for hallucination increases use a lower p threshold (p <= 0.05) but require absolute increase >0.3% and the same 3-window hysteresis. hallucination false-positives are noisier.

maria: ok I'll reduce to 1%, kick off the short_factual smoke suite, and enable auto-fallback policy id delta-mrr-2pct-p001-3w. will update the rollout ticket and paste the smoke eval link here.

ops-bot: policy created: id=abc123-delta-mrr-2pct-p001-3w. will post alerts to #incidents and trigger automatic traffic rollback to control if conditions met.

leo: thanks — ping when the smoke eval finishes and we can decide promote vs revert. :thumbsup:

maria: will do. thanks all.
